/// <summary>A bidirectional JSON-RPC transport. One client may consume each transport.</summary>
public interface IJsonRpcTransport : IAsyncDisposable
{
    /// <summary>Sends an envelope and correlates the reply; notifications return null after sending.</summary>
    ValueTask<JsonElement?> Send(JsonElement request, bool notification, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    /// <summary>Reads incoming requests and notifications independently from correlated responses. Use one reader.</summary>
    IAsyncEnumerable<JsonElement> ReadMessages(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    /// <summary>Writes a response to a server-initiated request, preserving its ID.</summary>
    ValueTask WriteResponse(JsonElement response, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    /// <summary>Completes when the connection closes, and faults on transport or framing errors.</summary>
    Task Completion { get; }
}
